title: A data table
description:
Define values of different sizes and print them.

```
byte: 200
word: 60000
dword: 4000000000
qword: 9000000000000000000
total of the first three: 4000060200
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
b8:     db      200
w16:    dw      60000
d32:    dd      4000000000
q64:    dq      9000000000000000000
s_byte: db      "byte: ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel s_byte]
        call    print_str
        movzx   edi, byte [rel b8]
        call    print_uint
        call    print_newline

        ; TODO: the other three and the total

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `movzx edi, word [rel w16]` reads 2 bytes and fills the rest of the register with zeros (lesson 1.05).
Add the first three in `rbx`, which the routines do not change.
requirements: Load each with the right size: `movzx` for the byte and word, `mov eax, [rel ...]` for the dword (which zero-extends), `mov rax` for the qword.
Print each with `print_uint` and a label string.
stretch: Print each value in hex with `print_hex` as well.
